Name: Simple Mastery Expansion (Replaced by Simple Skills Extended)
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[center][size=6][b][color=#67E8F9][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53458]✨ Simple Skills Extended HERE! ✨
[/url][/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center][b][color=#FDE68A]Simple Mastery Expansion continues as Simple Skills Extended![/color][/b]
Click the link above for SSE and choose the edition that suits your farm.[/center]

[center][size=6][b][color=#D8B4FE]✦ Simple Mastery Expansion ✦[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center]The mod has a new name: [b][color=#D8B4FE]Simple Skills Extended[/color][/b]. Continue developing Farming, Fishing, Foraging, Mining and Combat with automatic perks, extra permanent profession choices and a colourful Skills Journal.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#FDE68A]🌟 Choose Your Progression[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center]• [b][color=#D8B4FE]Level 100 — Main Download:[/color][/b] Longer progression with powerful late-game rewards and additional livestock, fishing, ore-vein and combat benefits.
• [b][color=#86EFAC]Level 30 — Optional Download:[/color][/b] The shorter progression path with its own reward curve.
Both editions include additional profession choices at levels 15, 20, 25 and 30, per-farmer effect controls, optional GMCM and all twelve game languages. Install only one edition.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#67E8F9]🔄 Moving From SME to SSE[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center]1. Remove the old [b]SimpleMasteryExpansion[/b] mod folder.
2. Extract your chosen SSE download into Mods, using its [b]SimpleSkillsExtended[/b] folder.
3. Launch through SMAPI. Do not keep SME and SSE installed together.
Existing extended XP, earned professions, pending choices and supported effect settings remain readable through migration. No manual save editing is needed.
If you use Simple World Tiers or Simple Experience Bar, update those companions to their SSE-compatible releases.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#86EFAC]📦 Requirements[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center]SSE requires [b]Stardew Valley 1.6.15+[/b] on desktop and [b]SMAPI 4.4.0+[/b]. GMCM is optional.
